algorithm: Select exact root/version and verified lifecycle request; revise requires an explicit successor, withdrawal requires explicit owner disposition
Enumerate complete registered consumers and transitive definition/artifact/mapping/profile/generated-output dependencies at one source cut
Record all observation cursors, manifest digest, unresolved consumers and traversal limits; no fabricated live Ontology Cut from file hashes
Refuse effect planning if coverage incomplete, unresolved, truncated or source cut changed
Propagate stale status through affected downstream handoffs; retain historical evidence and predecessor bytes
Build exact reviewed transition and permission proposal; use existing native lifecycle writer; separately publish canonical/source transition
successor_policy: successor-of is lineage only; it does not automatically supersede or withdraw
global_completeness_limit: Unknown external/unregistered consumers cannot be declared covered; explicitly bound the declared consumer universe and qualify it before effects.
